commentaire: Piotr PRZYDZIAL (Pol) was Race leader after Stage 2b, but was not taken into account for the official rankings, since he was still suspended with a 1-year ban, after a positive test for EPO in the Course de la Paix 2002. Therefore, no CQ-points are awarded for him.
titre: Szlakiem Grodow Piastowskich, Stage 2b : Lubin - Lubin (83 km)
